title: EFC -- v1.2 Foundational Framework
abstract: Foundational framework document for Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC). Defines core principles, field definitions (Energy Flow, Entropy, Grid), structural relationships, thermodynamic foundations, canonical terminology, and conceptual architecture forming the basis of the entire EFC project.
key_results: Defines the four fundamental EFC fields: Energy Flow, Entropy, Grid, and Information
Establishes thermodynamic first principles as the basis for cosmological dynamics
Introduces regime architecture (L0-L3) for scale-dependent physics
Maps structural relationships between entropy production and cosmic evolution
